headline: CNNIC reports more than 700 million generative-AI users in China by mid-2026
summary: CNNIC’s full 2026 report estimates more than 700 million generative-AI users in China and penetration above 50% by the first half of 2026, but footnote 12 says this is CNNIC’s calculation from unnamed network-data-platform data. It does not disclose the platform method, user/dedup definition, sampling frame or uncertainty. Other report measures are from December 2025 online/telephone questionnaires; its July 2026 app-use table cites QuestMobile TRUTH AI Insight and reports use counts in ten-thousand-use units, not unique users or productivity. The source record is now more specific, while independent validation and comparison with the 2025 user estimate remain unresolved.
